mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.FYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fymd , TO_CHAR(t1.TYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.TT AS tt , t1.INST_DAYS AS inst_days , TO_CHAR(t1.MANGI, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mangi_ymd , t1.DT AS dt , t1.CALL_Z AS z , t1.USD_TUJA AS usd_tuja FROM USPM_PORT t1 , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TYMD = #{ymd} AND t1.MANGI > #{ymd} AND LENGTH(t1.PORT_NUM) = 1 AND REGEXP_LIKE (t1.TT,'^[1-9]') AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD, t1.PORT_NUM

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , NVL(ya.SRS_CD, ya.BLBG_TCKR) AS srs_cd , ya.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , ya.JM_NM AS jm_nm , t1.COL AS col , t1.JONGA AS jonga , t1.CALL_PRICE AS call_price , t1.TARGET_RETURN_PER AS target_return_per , t1.USD_TUJA AS usd_tuja , (t1.USD_TUJA - NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI,0) - NVL(pp.opt_nominal_amt,0)) / NULLIF(t2.INST_DAYS, 0) AS mo_amt , t2.INST_DAYS AS inst_days , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.call_price,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN t1.USD_TUJA > (NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI,0) + NVL(pp.opt_nominal_amt,0)) THEN TRUNC((t1.USD_TUJA - NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI,0) - NVL(pp.opt_nominal_amt,0)) / NULLIF(t2.INST_DAYS, 0) / NULLIF(t1.call_price, 0) / 100, 0) ELSE 0 END END AS min_jusu , TO_CHAR(t2.FYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fymd , ya.CURRENCY AS currency , pp.OPT_QTY AS opt_qty , pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , pp.OPT_PREMIUM AS opt_premium , tt.risk_value AS risk_value , NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.TR_UP_JUSU, 0) - NVL(yz.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) AS stock_jusu , NVL(yz.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(yz.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK, 0) - NVL(yz.TR_DW_JUSU, 0) + NVL(yz.RIGHT_AEK, 0) AS stock_chui , 0 AS rt , F_OPT_COLOR (t1.CORP_GR, t1.YMD, t1.FUND_CD, t1.JM_CD, t1.JONGA) AS line_color FROM USPM t1 , USPM_PORT t2 , (SELECT t1.PORT , t1.JM_CD , t1.STOCK_JUSU , t1.STOCK_CHUI , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT , t1.OPT_QTY , t1.OPT_PREMIUM FROM USPM_OPT t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = #{ymd}) pp , SYM0YA ya , (SELECT yz.TRUSTEE , ya.CHANGE_JM_CD , SUM(NVL(yz.DELTA_RISK_VALUE,0) + NVL (yz.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE,0) + NVL (yz.VEGA_RISK_VALUE,0)) AS risk_value FROM SYM0YZ yz , SYM0YA ya WHERE yz.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND yz.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND yz.YMD = #{ymd} AND ya.CORP_GR = yz.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = yz.JM_CD GROUP BY yz.FUND_CD, yz.TRUSTEE, ya.CHANGE_JM_CD) tt , SYM0YZ yz WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = #{ymd} AND t1.PORT_NUM = #{portNum} AND t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND t2.TYMD = t1.YMD AND t2.PORT_NUM = t1.PORT_NUM AND pp.PORT(+) = '(' || #{portNum} || ')' AND pp.JM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND tt.TRUSTEE(+) = '(' || #{portNum} || ')' AND tt.CHANGE_JM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD AND yz.TRUSTEE(+) = '(' || #{portNum} || ')' AND yz.CORP_GR(+) = t1.CORP_GR AND yz.YMD(+) = t1.YMD AND yz.FUND_CD(+) = t1.FUND_CD AND yz.JM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM ASC, t1.COL ASC, t1.JM_CD ASC

SELECT t1.JM_CD AS opt_jm_cd , TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t1.JM_CD, LENGTH(#{jmCd}))) AS hangsa_ga , t1.BID AS bid , t1.ASK AS ask , t1.TIME_GA AS time_ga , t1.TVOL AS tvol , t1.TAMT AS tamt , t1.TOT_ASK_QNTT AS tot_ask_qntt , SUBSTR(t1.TRD_TO_DATE, 1, 6) AS mm , ROUND((TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t1.JM_CD, LENGTH(#{jmCd}))) / NULLIF(#{jonga}, 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS per , '매도' AS order_gb , 0 AS tr_su , t1.BID AS bid_ask , CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t1.JM_CD, LENGTH(#{jmCd}))) > 0 THEN ROUND(t1.ASK / TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t1.JM_CD, LENGTH(#{jmCd}))) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS compute1 FROM SYT0LP t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = #{ymd} AND t1.JM_CD LIKE #{jmCd} AND t1.TRD_TO_DATE = #{mangi} AND TRUNC(t1.BID / NULLIF(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t1.JM_CD, LENGTH(#{jmCd}))), 0), 4) * 100 BETWEEN #{targetReturnPer} AND 5.99 ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(t1.JM_CD, LENGTH(#{jmCd}))) ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(#{mangiYmd}, 'w') = '3' THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(#{mangiYmd}, 'w') END || #{srsCd} || t1.SRS_MM || TO_CHAR(#{mangiYmd}, 'yy') FROM SZX0YM t1 WHERE t1.YMD_GB = 'M' AND t1.YMD_ID = TO_CHAR(#{mangiYmd}, 'mm') AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT sebu_cd_efnm FROM SZX0GR t1 WHERE t1.gr_cd = 'TT' AND t1.sebu_cd = #{tt} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO API_Q ( COMPANY , URL , HEADERS , QUERYPARAMS , TABLENAME , SUBTABLE , REQUEST , API_KEY , KEY_VALUE , SUB_KEY_VALUE , CORP_GR , TR_YMD , KEY1 , KEY2 , KEY3 , KEY4 , NUM1 ) SELECT COMPANY , URL , HEADERS , '{ QRY_CNT: "1", SRS_CD_01: "' || #{jmCd} || '" }' , TABLENAME , SUBTABLE , '0' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID()) , KEY_VALUE , SUB_KEY_VALUE , #{corpGr} , SYSDATE , #{jmCd} , #{jmNm} , #{yjCd} , 'CALL' , #{hangsaGa} FROM API_PARAMS t1 WHERE t1.GR_CD = '17' AND t1.SCD = '20' AND t1.TR_CO_CD = '00003' AND t1.COMPANY = 'KB_REAL' AND ROWNUM = 1
